Account overview: salesenablement vendor building outbound chat agents (SDR assistant) that live in web app and in reps' inboxes. If hosted meets SLOs, procurement will evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and reduced per-token cost.

Key quotes: "We need streaming that's as responsive as a real chat — latency kills conversion" — VP Product. "Must be able to write to Salesforce and calendar without hitting rate-limits or breaking auth flows" — Head of Platform.

Technical asks / acceptance criteria:
- Streaming support with token-level partials (client-side). Must preserve order and support reconnection.
- Tool calling: OAuth handshake flow for Gmail/Exchange + SFDC write operations. Retry semantics and idempotency required.
- Latency SLOs: p50 <30ms, p95 <80ms for typical 128-token responses in US-east region.
- Fallbacks: automatic routing to smaller model variant if ephemeral overload; predictable behavior documented.
- Audit: per-request audit logging, KMS integration for keys, retention settings for transcripts.

- Week 1: streaming chat integration in staging, measure p50/p95, exercise reconnect and partial payloads.
- Week 2: tool-calls (create lead, send email template, schedule demo) + resilience tests; finish with demo to execs + cost estimate.
